denial.falsifier: A postprocessor class, inside the value-equality ceiling, that relates two streams whose def-use graphs differ by which chain a copy instruction sits in. Equivalently: evidence that ours and retail read the same value out of g0 at +0x30. The whole-body web table above gives both defining instructions; a falsifier would have to show one of them is misread.
denial.premise_measurement: `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wc_unproven_sweep.py --only pool_garbage_collect` at c621fcbac prints the same `+0x30: use of g0 is not value-equal to g0` for all four configurations. The MECHANISM is now read off the whole body rather than a three-instruction window: the streams differ in exactly four webs, each a bijection - gapCallback ours r30 <-> retail r31 (+0x14, used +0xc0); byte index i*4 ours r29 <-> retail r30 (+0xa4, +0xac, +0xe8); entries base ours r0 then r31 <-> retail r29 throughout (+0x28, +0x3c, +0x5c, +0x70, +0xac); node ours r5 throughout <-> retail r0 then r3 (+0x20, +0x2c, +0x3c, +0x44, +0x4c). The ONLY asymmetry is which of the last two webs the allocator left in the scratch r0 across +0x38 `slwi r0,r26,2`: that clobber forces exactly one copy out of r0 on either side and +0x30 IS that copy on both sides - ours copies the entries base (r0->r31), retail copies the node (r0->r3). The def-use graphs are therefore NOT isomorphic (the copy sits in a different chain) while the computation is identical, which is why the refusal is correct and the escape is required.

hypothesis.statement: The exhausted axis is the DECLARATION ORDER of the five locals (all 120 permutations). The untried axis is the STORAGE FORM of `entries` itself: `MemListNode** entries = lbl_8031EB00;` is a local pointer, and retail materialises the array base straight into a callee-saved register (+0x28 `addi r29,r3,@l`) while we materialise it into the scratch r0 and copy. Try (a) indexing the global directly at all five use sites (`lbl_8031EB00[count++] = node;` etc.) with no `entries` local at all, and (b) making `entries` const. Either changes which value the allocator parks in r0 across the +0x38 clobber, which is the single fact the escape rests on.
